finding.finding: Verified current evidence: S01 grid power is down, S09 grid power is down, and link L09 (S08 Homagama to S09 Padukka) is down. No equipment status is established.

The verified faults have matching catalogue actions: S01 and S09 have grid-power failures, and L09 has a backhaul failure. Crews C1 and C2 are at DEPOT with equipment and generator skills, but neither has the required backhaul skill for BH-L09. No crew has a backhaul skill listed. G1 is available at DEPOT; roads to the affected locations are listed with no reported closures. No evidence establishes that a generator is needed or that any action is unsafe or impossible, so no action is deferred.

questions.question: Which available crew has the required backhaul skill to repair L09, or can a backhaul-skilled crew be made available?

finding.finding: Apply approved weights unchanged: S09 (Padukka) is critical at weight 5; all other services are standard at weight 1. The failed L09 link also disconnects S09 from the core. S01 (Beruwala) is also down because grid power is unavailable and its authoritative snapshot reports AC mains failure with operation on battery.
